        How to: Create a New Details Page

User Interface Extensibility
 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Detail Pages
 > How to: Create a New Details Page
    
    
    
        The tooling provided for creating a new custom Details page is not complete. For now, follow the instructions below in order to create a new Details page.


     Step 1: Copy an Existing Details Page Script



    Browse to the directory that SCALE is installed to and then go to the sub folder Database | ILS | Scripts | _Metadata | Detail. Pick a script for a screen that is the most similar to the page you want to create. Copy the script to another location, rename it, and open it.



     Step 2: Update Script with Page Level information



    Update the script for all page level information as follows:

     

    
        Form Id: Use a different Form Id for your new screen. At the top of the script you will see the Form Id being set similar to this: set @formId = 2767. Search and replace the actual Form Id value in the script with your new Form Id. The new Form Id value you use should be the next available Form Id >= 60,000. So in the example given above, the Form Id 2767 should be replaced by 60000 everywhere in the script.

        
            Form record: Update the call to DBC_IFORM as follows:

            
                @formKeyName = MNU_<customScreenName>Details (i.e. MNU_CustomDetails)

                @tableName = the name of the NHibernateEntity that represents the SQL table that should be used for the Details screen data

                @associatedFormKey = null
            
        

        Security: Remove all calls to dbc_ISecurityCheckpoint except for security_checkpoint 1, 3, and 6 ("run", "change", "display").

        
            Screen record: Update the call to DBC_IMAINUISCREEN as follows:

            
                @functionalArea = the identifier of the functional area you want the screen to show up under in the menu

                @menuResourceKey = the Resource Key to be used for the page title

                @path = Update based on the NHibernate entity that will be used for the page (i.e. /scale/details/<NHibernateEntityName>

                @restrictionsId = set this to the configured Spring Id for the .NET class that will house the "restrictions" list for the screen, if any (see the Field Restrictions topic for more information)

                @defaultsId = set this to the configured Spring Id for the .NET class that will house the "defaults" list for the screen, if any (see the Detail Defaults topic for more information)
            
        

        Licensing: Remove all calls to dbc_IMainUiWmLicenseXrefOriginal.
    



     Step 3: Run the Modified Script



    Open SQL Server Management Studio and run the modified script ensuring there are no errors. Run an IISRESET and then try to browse to the new page. The URL will be in the format https://<serverName>/scale/details/<NHibernateEntityName>/<internalId>. The new Details page may not be shown properly, since the controls on the screen do not bind with teh proper NHibernateEntity yet.



     Step 4: Modify the General Controls on the Page



    Now that the new page exists, we can modify the screen metadata for the general controls on the page using either Insight Architect (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page ), modifying the script mentioned above, or straight SQL against the database. Reference the topics How to: Modify an Existing Details Page and How to: Create Section Headers on a Detail/Transaction Screen  for a general overview of the Details page metadata.



     Step 5: Modify any Grids on the Page



    Now modify the screen metadata for any grids that need to be on the page using either Insight Architect (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page ), modifying the script mentioned above, or straight SQL against the database. Reference the topic How to: Add a Grid to a Detail/Transaction Screen for a general overview of the metadata for grids on a Details page.



     Step 6: Modify the Actions



    Now modify the screen metadata for the Actions on the page using either Insight Architect (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page ), modifying the script mentioned above, or straight SQL against the database. Reference the topic How to: Add Detail Screen Menu Options for a general overview of the Actions metadata.

            
            See Also
How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page

     Step 1: Copy an Existing Details Page Script





    
Browse to the directory that SCALE is installed to and then go to the sub folder Database | ILS | Scripts | _Metadata | Detail. Pick a script for a screen that is the most similar to the page you want to create. Copy the script to another location, rename it, and open it.






     Step 2: Update Script with Page Level information





    
Update the script for all page level information as follows:


    
 


    

        
Form Id: Use a different Form Id for your new screen. At the top of the script you will see the Form Id being set similar to this: set @formId = 2767. Search and replace the actual Form Id value in the script with your new Form Id. The new Form Id value you use should be the next available Form Id >= 60,000. So in the example given above, the Form Id 2767 should be replaced by 60000 everywhere in the script.


        

            Form record: Update the call to DBC_IFORM as follows:

            

                
@formKeyName = MNU_<customScreenName>Details (i.e. MNU_CustomDetails)


                
@tableName = the name of the NHibernateEntity that represents the SQL table that should be used for the Details screen data


                
@associatedFormKey = null

            

        


        
Security: Remove all calls to dbc_ISecurityCheckpoint except for security_checkpoint 1, 3, and 6 ("run", "change", "display").


        

            Screen record: Update the call to DBC_IMAINUISCREEN as follows:

            

                
@functionalArea = the identifier of the functional area you want the screen to show up under in the menu


                
@menuResourceKey = the Resource Key to be used for the page title


                
@path = Update based on the NHibernate entity that will be used for the page (i.e. /scale/details/<NHibernateEntityName>


                
@restrictionsId = set this to the configured Spring Id for the .NET class that will house the "restrictions" list for the screen, if any (see the Field Restrictions topic for more information)

Open SQL Server Management Studio and run the modified script ensuring there are no errors. Run an IISRESET and then try to browse to the new page. The URL will be in the format https://<serverName>/scale/details/<NHibernateEntityName>/<internalId>. The new Details page may not be shown properly, since the controls on the screen do not bind with teh proper NHibernateEntity yet.

Now that the new page exists, we can modify the screen metadata for the general controls on the page using either Insight Architect (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page ), modifying the script mentioned above, or straight SQL against the database. Reference the topics How to: Modify an Existing Details Page and How to: Create Section Headers on a Detail/Transaction Screen  for a general overview of the Details page metadata.

Now modify the screen metadata for any grids that need to be on the page using either Insight Architect (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page ), modifying the script mentioned above, or straight SQL against the database. Reference the topic How to: Add a Grid to a Detail/Transaction Screen for a general overview of the metadata for grids on a Details page.
